scenes.title: 微笑，挥挥手！
scenes.english: Just smile and wave, boys. Smile and wave.
quotes: Just smile and wave, boys. Smile and wave.
小伙子们，微笑，挥挥手。微笑，挥挥手。
Kowalski, progress report.
科瓦斯基，报告进展。
We're only five hundred feet from the main sewer line.
距离主下水道只剩五百英尺了。
And the bad news?
那坏消息呢？
We've broken our last shovel.
我们的最后一把铲子也断了。
Right. Rico, you're on litter patrol. We need shovels, and find more Popsicle sticks. You don't want to risk another cave-in.
好。瑞哥，你去找废弃物。我们需要铲子，再找些冰棒棍。你可不想再冒塌方的风险。
And me, Skipper?
那我呢，队长？
I want you to look cute and cuddly, Private.
你的任务是保持可爱，菜鸟。

scenes.title: 你许了什么愿？
quotes: Come on, what'd you wish for?
快说，你许了什么愿？
No, can't tell you that.
不能告诉你。
Come on, tell.
说嘛。
No siree, I'm telling you, it's bad luck. You want some bad luck? I'll blab it out. But if you want to be safe, I'll keep...
不行，说出来会倒霉的。你想倒霉的话，我就说。要想平安的话……
Would you just tell us? I mean, really, what could happen?
告诉我们吧，到底能发生什么？
Okay. I wished I could go to the wild.
好吧，我希望能去野外。
The wild?
野外？
Whoa. I told you it was bad luck.
看吧，我就说会倒霉。

scenes.title: 纽约巨人
quotes: You must tell me, who the heck are you?
快告诉我，你们究竟是谁？
I'm Alex. The Alex. And this is Gloria, Marty, Melman.
我是艾力狮。这是格洛丽亚、马蒂和梅尔曼。
Just where are you giants from?
你们这些巨人从哪里来？
We're from New York.
我们来自纽约。
All hail the New York Giants!
向纽约巨人致敬！

scenes.title: 这盏灯是什么意思？
quotes: Skipper, look.
老大，快看。
Analysis.
分析一下。
It looks like a small incandescent bulb designed to indicate something out of the ordinary, like a malfunction.
看起来是个小灯泡，用来指示异常情况，比如故障。
I find it pretty and somewhat hypnotic.
我觉得它挺漂亮，还有点催眠。
That too, sir.
也有这个作用，长官。
Right. Rico. Manual. Problem solved.
好，瑞哥，手册。问题解决了。
Sir, we may be out of fuel.
长官，我们可能没油了。
What makes you think that?
你怎么知道？
We've lost engine one. And engine two is no longer on fire.
一号发动机停了，二号发动机也不冒火了。

scenes.title: 出了点小状况
quotes: Good evening, officers.
警官们，晚上好。
No, no, no. You don't talk now, okay? You're not so good with the putting the words together and they're coming out good thing. You keep it shh.
别说了。你不太擅长组织语言，你先安静一下。

Hey, how you doing? Yeah, you know what? Everything's cool. We just had a little situation here. Little internal situation. Actually, my friend just went a little crazy. Happens to everybody. The city gets to us all. Just went a little cuckoo in the head.
你们好，一切正常。我们只是出了点小状况，内部小状况。我朋友有点失控，这种事谁都会遇到。这座城市让大家都有压力，他只是脑子有点糊涂。
Hey, don't be calling me cuckoo in the head!
别说我脑子糊涂！
Just shh.
嘘。
